An '''Emitter Antenna''' was a component used on [[planetary shield generator]]s such as [[CoMar Combat Systems/Legends|CoMar's]] [[SLD-26 planetary shield generator/Legends|SLD-26 model]]. The antenna were located at the apex of the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]], connected to the [[Amplification Projector]].<ref name="EGWT" />
